evidence_items.publisher: Nature; author-hosted copy at the University of Toronto
evidence_items.explanation: The technical description links deep learning to processing layers and learned abstractions. Reading this as an architectural description rather than a guarantee of understanding is the evaluator's inference.

The textbook explicitly connects deep learning with learning concepts. This qualifies 'just': it challenges a reading that denies conceptual learning altogether, but does not establish guaranteed conceptual understanding.

The original Go study supports the narrower point that strong performance can coexist with unexpected vulnerabilities. It does not measure conceptual depth or prove that the system lacks all conceptual representations.

unresolved_gaps: There is no supplied threshold or direct measurement of 'conceptual depth'. The evidence cannot settle the stronger claim that deep learning is incapable of conceptual understanding.
